title: Changing the one field writes a log entry with before and after
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Change Sales Representative to sales rep A.
  2. Open the work order's menu.
  3. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The field reads sales rep A.

Step 2:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The newest entry is "Sales representative changed" reading "Sales Representative: Unassigned → [sales rep A's name]".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S7-R1: “Each change to a work order's representatives, including adding or removing the Parts field, writes one log entry, "Sales representative changed". Adding the Parts field with the same person on both sides is a change and writes one entry, for example "Sales Representative: Ann Able → Ann Able (Parts) · Ann Able (Labor)".”
  • S7-R2: “The entry shows "Sales Representative: {before} → {after}". A work order that is not split reads the one name, or "Unassigned".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
